name: Philter of Love

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Charmed for 1 hour by the next creature you see within 10 minutes of drinking it.
text: This fizzy, rose-colored drink hides a single heart-shaped bubble that is easy to overlook. After drinking it, the first creature you see within the next 10 minutes becomes your one true love: for 1 hour you have the Charmed condition, seeing that creature through adoring eyes.
